rationale: B. pseudocatenulatum ferments glucose and arabinose via bifid shunt to acetate (major), lactate, and formate. Amino acids (arginine, serine) provide supplemental C and N. At 12 h, I exit lag phase and commit to balanced growth at 0.30 /h, sustainable for remaining 36 h. Carbon and nitrogen budgets close; fermentation products match known bifid metabolism.
